description: This file is a designer-generated C# partial class for an ASP.NET Web Forms page. It defines controls such as panels, labels, buttons, a GridView, and a SqlDataSource for the AdminQueue page of an online examination system. The controls are used to build the UI for the admin's queue management interface.
